items.title: Higher Airfares Are Here to Stay, but Don’t Expect Airline Profits to Rise
items.summary: Jet fuel costs are hitting new highs, eating into the gains from higher airfares. Delta is expected to be among the few U.S. airlines to see a profit this year.

items.title: Tour Operators Adapt to Climate Risk After Fatal Himalayan Disasters
items.summary: Climate is already a business risk that Himalayan tour operators grapple with, absorbing cancellations and rerouting. The bigger exposure is the destination itself as disasters reveal its fragility.

items.title: More Than a Quarter of Saudi Flights Disrupted by Houthi Strikes
items.summary: With the Gulf’s main airports now targets, the region’s hub model is losing the reliability it sells.

items.title: Why Hotel Operators Need to Think More Like Owners
items.summary: Asset-light growth can help hotel companies scale faster, but owners still carry the capital risk. Operators with skin in the game may be better positioned to test ideas, challenge investment assumptions, and focus on long-term hotel value.

items.title: Duetto Buys Flyr Hospitality as Airline Tech Firm Exits Hotel Pricing
items.summary: Four years after Flyr bought its way into hotels, it's handing the unit to one of the two rivals Skift said it would have to beat.

items.title: She Started as the Receptionist. Now She’s the CEO.

items.title: Dubai’s Luxury Hotels Add Perks to Avoid Rate Cuts
items.summary: Dubai’s luxury hotels face a choice between protecting rates and filling rooms. Value-adds let them do some of both. The question is how long their 2025 buffers will last.
